assets.name: journey-balloon-sprite.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 12-frame transparent animated sprite sheet for a subtle website accent.
Primary request: one small elegant classic hot-air balloon, softly rounded vertically striped envelope, delicate ropes and a tiny wicker basket. Cream envelope with very pale teal and muted mustard panel washes. Repeat the same balloon in 12 precise animation frames.
Style/medium: original vintage editorial pen-and-ink illustration, sophisticated black etched outlines and short woodcut crosshatching, deliberately sparse detail, cream #fffaf3, very pale teal and muted mustard hand-painted wash. Flat illustrated artwork, not photorealism, not 3D, not glossy, no drop shadow. Premium restrained editorial website accent.
Sprite-sheet layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows, EXACTLY TWELVE equal square cells, row-major frame order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Canvas 1536x1152 pixels, each cell 384x384. No visible grid, borders, labels, guides, frame numbers or padding between cells. Every subject is completely inside its own cell with clear transparent margins. Fixed orthographic camera, identical scale and consistent center/anchor across all 12 frames. Genuine fully transparent alpha background, no white fill, no checkerboard drawn in. This is a 12-frame seamless looping 2D game-style animation sprite sheet, not 12 unrelated drawings.
Frame composition: the balloon including basket fills exactly 65 percent of each cell height, centered at the same coordinates. Broad transparent margin surrounds it. Outline and scale stay consistent.
Motion: extremely restrained seamless sway and canvas breathing. Envelope tilt progresses through 0, +1, +2, +2, +1, 0, 0, -1, -2, -2, -1, 0 degrees across frames; center does not translate. Basket has a tiny corresponding tilt. Canvas only barely expands/contracts. Final frame returns to first pose.
Avoid: scenery, people, faces, decorative clouds, flight trails, extra balloons within a cell, text, labels, UI, grid, shadows, background color.

assets.name: hero-ink-landscape.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: very wide original editorial landscape illustration for a premium minimalist website.
Primary request: sparse bold black vintage pen and woodcut Canadian river, prairie and pine landscape on solid warm cream #fffaf3. Panoramic 3:1 composition, approximately 2520x840 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: an open river winds calmly from foreground into distant low prairie hills. Strong black pine trees frame only far left and far right. Subtle flat muted mustard horizon wash and very pale mint in a few areas of water.
Style/medium: bold artistic black ink contours, sparse confident woodcut strokes, vintage editorial etching, simple expressive shapes, hand-drawn, stylish and flat. Lots of clean negative space, restrained details. Much less detailed than a dense engraving; do not turn it into a realistic photo or highly detailed naturalistic scene.
Composition: upper half mostly clean uninterrupted cream. Landscape concentrated in lower half with a low horizon. Black trees at extreme edges may rise only a little above the horizon; wide central sky is completely empty. Winding river makes an open path into the distance. A few strong crosshatched areas balanced with large cream gaps.
Color palette: solid #fffaf3 background, near-black linework, subtle muted mustard horizon and pale mint washes, no gradients.
Constraints: no drones, aircraft, hot-air balloons, buildings, people, text, symbols, logos, watermark, UI, border or frame. Flat sparse illustrated artwork.

assets.prompt:
